# Event commands

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-event-docs.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Event command lists are arrays of `{code, indent, parameters}`. The codes and
parameter layouts are the same as RPG Maker MZ, so MZ references apply.
At runtime `Game_Interpreter.prototype.commandNNN(params)` runs code NNN.
Return `false` from a command to wait and retry it next frame.

A list always ends with code `0` (an empty line at the block's indent).

## Continuation and block codes

These lines belong to the command above them and are edited with it:

`401`, `402`, `403`, `404`, `405`, `408`, `411`, `412`, `413`, `505`, `601`, `602`, `603`, `604`, `605`, `655`, `657`

Block ends: `411` Else, `412` End (If), `413` Repeat Above (Loop), `402`/`403`/`404`
choice branches, `601`–`604` battle result branches.
